Web Application

src.app.create_app(test_config=None)

Create and configure the Flask application.

The application factory creates the Flask instance, applies any test-specific configuration, sets the default data-pull and analysis update functions, and registers the application’s routes.

Parameters:

test_config (dict or None) – Optional configuration values to apply to the Flask application. Existing configuration values are updated with these values when provided.

Returns:

Configured Flask application instance.

Return type:

flask.Flask

src.app.register_routes(flask_app)

Register all application routes on a Flask application instance.

The registered routes handle starting and resuming data pulls, reporting pull status, displaying analysis results, refreshing analysis, and serving the application’s stylesheet.

Parameters:

flask_app (flask.Flask) – Flask application instance on which the routes should be registered.

Returns:

None.

Return type:

None
